description: This is a C# source file defining the UserInfoController class for handling OpenID Connect userinfo endpoint requests within an OrchardCore module. It processes access tokens, validates claims, and returns user information in JSON format.

classes.name: UserInfoController
classes.description: Controller handling the OpenID Connect userinfo endpoint, returning user claims based on access token scopes.

methods.name: Me
methods.description: Handles GET/POST requests to the /connect/userinfo endpoint, validates the request, extracts user claims, and returns them as JSON.
